string.text: Standard 6x5 bayonet allows to use the weapon in melee combat. Due to constructional characteristics of the weapon, suppressors cannot be attached with the bayonet installed.
Improves reliability of the firearm by replacing standard parts of the trigger group with their reinforced counterparts.
Individual adjustment and balancing of the standard parts of the trigger mechanism improve accuracy, while simultaneously lowering recoil.
Modern muzzle brake Significantly reduces muzzle climb and felt recoil, which improves accuracy.
Balanced bolt carrier group decreases muzzle climb.
Reinforced steel bolt carrier significantly increases the number of times the bolt can cycle without maintenance.
maintenance magazine reduces overall weight of the firearm.
Individual adjustment of the standard parts of the feeding mechanism decreases the probability of malfunctions related to feeding issues.
Modified gas block is more effective at redirecting gas from the barrel. Increases muzzle velocity while simultaneously reducing recoil.
Lighter stock allows to reduce overall weight of the firearm.
Anatomical rubberized recoil pad reduced felt recoil.
Reduces overall weight of the weapon.
Application of a protective coating reduces wear of the mechanisms.
Tritium-illuminated sights increase speed and comfort of aiming in poorly-lit environments.
Special pad installed on the stock reduces felt recoil.
Reinforced barrel is more wear-resistant. Improves durability of the firearm.

Improves accuracy with sniper cartridges, which are more common in the Zone than other variants of 7.62x54mmR ammunition. (Since the 1970s standard twist rate of SVD barrels has been 240mm (1:9.4 in), which was adopted to facilitate the use of tracer and AP incendiary ammunition, at the cost of accuracy with the sniper round).
Increases muzzle velocity and effective range.
